observations.body: The LORD announces covenant wonders, commands guarded allegiance and festivals, and Moses remains forty days without food or water as the covenant words—the Ten Commandments—are written on tablets.
observations.label: Renewed covenant words reach the Ten Commandments

observations.body: Renewed covenant words reach the Ten Commandments belongs to covenant renewed in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 34:10–28 supplies aftermath evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Renewal answers the breach without erasing the broken tablets, the judgment, or the need for pardon.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 34:10–28 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Renewed covenant words reach the Ten Commandments belongs to the covenant renewed movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
